title: Sunday · three drawings on a wall
logline: The garage wall with Lyon's glow, Osaka's dog and Montreal's envelope, unopened yet. Three strangers on a wall, as a Sunday, the week before the arc's dailies.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the garage wall: two drawings pinned — a ridge with a glow, a dog under a table in a loose wet line — and a third envelope, airmail-striped, unopened, pinned by its corner.

image.prompt: a garage wall with two pinned drawings, one of a forested ridge with a soft glow and one of a dog under a table in loose wet brush, and beside them an unopened airmail envelope pinned by its corner, no words
image.notes: Lyon and Osaka up; Montreal unopened until dw_2012-11-16.

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: Lyon's drawing, close: the ridge, the glow, in a stranger's hand.

image.prompt: close on a stranger's drawing of a forested ridge with a soft warm glow above it in a different hand, no words

panels.name: Glow

panels.composition: Tier 3: the wall at night, the lamp's circle reaching the drawings' bottom edge and no further. Held.

image.prompt: a garage wall at night with a lamp's circle of light reaching the bottom edge of two pinned drawings and an envelope, no words

panels.name: Lamp

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Three strangers on the wall, one unopened.
